身だしなみ is the work of reducing information that never needed to be read

Where is the floor of「最低限」for grooming? If the standard is style, beauty, or vague「清潔感」, the task has no obvious stopping point. This essay reframes grooming as reducing unintended visual noise. Research on first impressions, person perception through dress, visual clutter, and processing fluency helps separate evidence from the essay's interpretation: minimum grooming is less about adding attractiveness and more about preventing accidental, fixable information from stealing attention from the actual interaction.
